claim: At e<=0.6 (N=64, seeds 70-72, 10-step checkpoints), the layer-4 accel_step best-of-5 control R2 is 0.667-0.682 in all 3 seeds, inside the predicted [0.58, 0.70] band. The other two predictions were met in only some seeds. Final accel_step margin is 0.187 (seed 71), 0.191 (seed 70) and 0.204 (seed 72), so only seed 72 reaches the 0.20 bar, though no seed falls to the <=0.18 'false' bar. Raw R2 is 0.868-0.871 in all 3 seeds. The persistent 0.1-bar formation step read from the trajectories is 80 (seed 71, margin 0.113), 70 or 80 (seed 70: exactly 0.100 at step 70, while formed_at_step says 80) and 60 (seed 72). Force is much weaker than accel_step: R2 0.46-0.58 at layer 4 with margins of 0.075 (fails), 0.105 and 0.140.
confidence_note: Only the control R2 prediction held in all 3 seeds. The margin prediction (>=0.20) holds in 1 of 3 seeds. The timing prediction (<=75) holds in 1 seed, fails in seed 71 (step 80), and is undecidable in seed 70, where the margin is exactly 0.100 at step 70 and formed_at_step reports 80. So neither the 'all 3 seeds' true condition nor the '2 of 3 seeds' false condition is cleanly met. The e<=0.6 values lie between the e<=0.5 and e<=0.7 regimes as quoted in the open questions (margin about 0.13-0.17 / 0.19 / 0.24-0.26; formation about 65-100 / 60-80 / 60-70). That fits a gradual shift better than a switch at or below 0.6, but it is not a clean refutation. The control R2 fell only about 0.06 from e<=0.5 to e<=0.6 but about 0.12 from 0.6 to 0.7, which points to a non-linear control decline. Raw accel_step R2 (about 0.87) looks close to the e<=0.5 values, so most of the margin gain may come from the falling control rather than better decoding. Headroom-normalized margins are 0.59-0.61. Caveats: the e<=0.5 and e<=0.7 comparison numbers come from other experiments with different seeds, some with 5-step checkpoints, while this run uses 10-step spacing, so a difference of one checkpoint (10 steps) decides the timing criterion. What would change the verdict: rerunning e<=0.5, 0.6 and 0.7 on the same seeds 70-72 with 5-step checkpoints, plus a documented rule for whether a margin exactly at 0.100 counts as crossing the bar. Other observations: val_mse_ratio at formation is 2.9-3.5, between the reported e<=0.5 band (2.1-3.3) and the e<=0.7 band (2.9-4.1). Distance forms at steps 30-40, 20-50 steps before accel_step. The early force transient appears again (margin 0.08-0.125 at steps 10-20, falling to 0.001-0.033 by steps 40-50).

notes.text: Response to review r-20261012-070236-2512 (issue 0): Accepted. Seed 70's raw margin at step 70 is 0.0998 (R2 0.7786 vs control 0.6788), which is below the >= 0.1 bar, so its persistent formation step is 80 and agrees with formed_at_step. There is no lag in this run, and calling the step 'exactly 0.100' and 'undecidable' was a rounding misread. With seed 71 also at 80, 2 of 3 seeds form at step >= 80, which meets expected_if_false (formation <= 75 fails in 2 of 3 seeds). The correct verdict is refuted: at e<=0.6 the formation step has not shifted to the high-e value of 60-70. The control-R2 prediction (0.667-0.682, inside [0.58, 0.70]) did hold in all 3 seeds, and that part stands as an observation. Open question q-20261012-065147-5d5b starts from the same misreading. Seed 70 should be removed from the one-checkpoint-lag cases cited in q-20261012-032843-df65. This cycle's matched e<=0.5 arm on seeds 70-72 completes the sweep on the same seeds.

Response to review r-20261012-070236-2512 (issue 0): Accepted. Seed 70's unrounded margin at step 70 is 0.0998 (R2 0.7786 vs control 0.6788), which is below the >= 0.1 bar. Its persistent formation step is therefore 80, the same as formed_at_step, so there is no lag here. Seeds 70 and 71 both form at step 80, which is >= 80 in 2 of 3 seeds and meets expected_if_false as written. The margin criterion (>= 0.20) also fails in 2 of 3 seeds. The correct verdict is refuted: at e<=0.6, margin and timing have not yet switched to their high-e values. The control-R2 band prediction did hold in all 3 seeds, so control R2 is intermediate while timing still looks like the low-e regime. q-20261012-065147-5d5b rests on the same misreading and should be closed as answered (no lag, the margin was 0.0998). This cycle's seed-matched e<=0.5 and e<=0.85 arms complete the sweep.
